nodes.name: 包舌的钟
who: the net-mender in the small boat
nodes.light: warm lantern-orange on the captain and the bell, against the cold grey-blue of a night fog bank that swallows everything beyond
nodes.camera: low on the bow deck beside the captain, looking up at him and past him at the wall of fog; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late-autumn night at sea outside a small harbour, a heavy wall of white fog standing across the picture and swallowing the sea beyond it. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a huge broad-shouldered ship captain stands on the bow of a sturdy wooden ship: Hakon has short cropped flame-red hair and a red beard braided into two short plaits, pale ice-blue eyes, a wind-reddened face, and he wears a thick grey wool coat and an oilcloth cape. A small bronze bell whose clapper is wrapped in leather hangs from the bow rail on a cord, and he is striking it with a wooden mallet in his right hand, swung back; his left hand grips the rail beside it and has only four fingers, with a short healed stump where the little finger should be, clearly visible. His mouth is open, bellowing, his face turned toward the fog. On the bell eleven or twelve short lines are cut. Lanterns hang from the ship's mast and rail, and the ship's rope ends trail in the dark water. Out in the fog, small and pale, the broken mast of a damaged fishing boat just shows its top, and a little further a second bow comes out of the white. In the lower left of the picture, far behind the ship on the dark water, a very small rowing boat follows with one girl at the oars: Tina is nineteen, black curly hair in one thick plait, sea-teal eyes, a small brass thimble on a cord at her neck; she is rowing hard, her face turned toward the ship's lantern, her mouth shut. Fine mist, drifting rope ends and a few large out-of-focus drops of water cross the near corners.

nodes.name: 鳞光
nodes.light: faint teal-green glow coming up through the water from below the hull, onto both faces, against dense grey-white fog all round
nodes.camera: from the stern, over the helmsman's shoulder, looking forward along the boat at the girl in the bow and the fog ahead; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a small open wooden boat alone on a flat grey sea inside thick fog, in midwinter, the fog standing all around so that we see only a few boat-lengths of water. We look from the stern. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one cheek and one sea-teal eye, sits the helmsman at the tiller: Joen is a gaunt, tall man with untidy black curly hair crusted with salt, a short beard, an old scar through the left eyebrow, deep laugh lines, a patched oilcloth coat; round his waist hangs a leather waterskin whose mouth cord is tied in dozens of knots, and his hand rests on the knotted cord, his fingers just stopped on one knot. His face is calm and shut, his eyes on the water ahead, not on the girl. In the bow, small and turned toward us, a fox-eared fisher girl of eighteen sits wrapped in a blanket: Suki has messy short orange-red hair, pointed fox ears with white tips, a big fluffy white-tipped tail curled round her feet, gold up-tilted eyes, a small fox tooth showing in a grin, and a small bone whistle on a cord at her neck. She is talking with her hands, her mouth open, telling a story, and she looks very tired and very happy to be alive. Under the boat, in the clear dark water just below the surface, a long row of small pale teal scales glimmers and keeps pace with the boat on one side, lighting the underside of the hull. Wisps of fog and a few large out-of-focus drops of water drift across the near corners.

nodes.name: 合拢的礁
nodes.light: the orange of the burning grass on the creature's back, against the pale grey-gold of the fog as it begins to lift
nodes.camera: low on the reef rock behind the girl, looking up past her at the creature and the man on its back; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: late afternoon at the mouth of a small harbour, between two long grey reefs that curve toward each other like two hands almost closed. Jammed tight between the two reef-arms, filling the whole middle of the picture, is an enormous whale-like creature whose back looks like a small grassy island: its back is covered in dry grass, scrubby bushes and a few nesting birds, and the grass is on fire from end to end, a long orange line of flame rolling away from us across its back with thick smoke streaming up. Its head is turned toward us and a single huge yellowish eye, bigger than a ship's sail, is rolled up in the side of its head, glowing like a dim lamp. On its back, in the middle of the picture, small and sharp, stands a lean tall man with untidy black curly hair, a gaunt face with a short beard and a scar through the left eyebrow, an oilcloth coat scorched at the hem, a leather waterskin at his belt with its cord knotted dozens of times; Joen has just driven a battered fish-spear down into the great eye with both hands, his whole weight on it, his mouth open in a shout, flames tossing round his legs. Behind the creature a bank of fog is rolling out toward the open sea, and the masts of a small harbour and the roofs of a hillside village are already coming clear in it, with one tiny lit lamp on a doorstep halfway up. In the near right foreground on the reef rock, large and seen from behind at three-quarter, crouches the fox-eared girl, Suki, orange-red messy hair, white-tipped fox ears flat back, tail fluffed out, a small bone whistle held to her lips with both hands, her gold eyes wide on the man; she has just blown it. Sparks, smoke and flying bits of burning grass rush past large and out of focus across the corners.

nodes.name: 未熄的灯
nodes.light: low warm gold of a late-autumn sunset coming through the open door onto the floor and the net, with the soft blue shade of the house behind her
nodes.camera: from inside the room, at floor level beside her stool, looking out across the net on her lap through the open door at the man on the step; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the doorway of a small stone fisher's house on a hillside above a harbour, at sunset. We look from inside the house. In the near left foreground, on a low stool, sits a young woman of nineteen with her back half turned to us, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one cheek: Tina has black curly hair in one thick plait down her back, thick straight brows, sea-teal eyes, a small brass thimble on a cord at her neck, and she wears a plain patched blue dress. A heap of fishing net lies across her lap and she is finishing a knot with a bone netting-needle in her fine, callused fingers, and has not yet raised her head. On the inside of the open door, in the near right foreground, hangs a framed painting, an old charcoal portrait of a broad-faced, round-cheeked younger sailor smiling, in a plain wooden frame, a little faded. A small oil lamp hangs lit above the door-lintel outside, its flame pale against the sunset. Standing on the step outside, in the middle of the picture, a gaunt tall man looks in at her: Joen has untidy black curly hair crusted with salt, a short beard, an old scar through the left eyebrow, sea-teal eyes, an oilcloth coat worn thin and a leather waterskin at his belt with its cord knotted in dozens of knots; he is much thinner than the man in the picture. He stands very still, one hand half-lifted at his side, his lips closed, his eyes wet and steady on her. Far down the hill behind him, small, the harbour with its masts and the grey-blue sea lie in the evening light. A few dust motes and drifting seabird feathers hang large and out of focus across the near corners.

notes: 这一段四个旅伴和相遇的人都没有死在2899到2900年以内：约恩约2960年出海没回，汀娜约2975年，哈康约2945年，苏琪约2980年，都在这一段以外，所以 deaths 是空的。
三幕 beast 填 moon_015_2，没有看过那三张参考图的内容，凭“第二阶＝受伤的雾岛”猜的，出图前请主会话确认第几阶画的是背上长草的岛。
约恩在任务单里是“相遇”，who 里照样给了键，二幕、三幕、收束都用他。
一幕画的是哈康敲钟领船出湾，汀娜划小船跟在后头，苏琪那一条船不画（还在雾里）。
收束选的是汀娜补完那个结抬头以前，约恩站在门外台阶上那一刻，台词那一句“你比画上瘦”还没说出口。
苏琪的父亲（无名渔夫）2899年霜降月风暴里船翻在雾里没浮上来，不是旅伴也不是相遇条目，没进 fates。
